camel_example: aliyun clickhouse CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --Account test1 --DBInstanceId 'cc-bp100p4q1g9z30000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccountType NormalAccount --Password 'a1b2c3d4@'
description_en: Creates a database account for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse Enterprise Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateAccount接口为云数据库ClickHouse企业版集群创建数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-account --db-instance-id cc-bp100p4q1g9z30000 --account-type NormalAccount --account test1 --password a1b2c3d4@ --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database account. Valid values:

NormalAccount: standard account

SuperAccount: privileged account
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的类型，取值说明：
NormalAccount：普通账号。
SuperAccount：高权限账号
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号，设置规则如下。
名称唯一。
由小写字母、数字或下划线组成。
以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
长度为2~64个字符
parameters.name: account

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

The following special characters are supported: ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号密码，设置规则如下。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符中的至少三种组成。

!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。

长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: password

fields.help_en: The databases on which you want to grant permissions. Separate multiple databases with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 需要授权的数据库列表。如果有多个，用英文逗号（,）隔开
fields.name: allow_databases

fields.help_en: The dictionaries on which you want to grant permissions. Separate multiple dictionaries with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 需要授权的字典列表。如果有多个，用英文逗号（,）隔开
fields.name: allow_dictionaries

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant the DDL permissions to the database account. Valid values:

true: The account has the permissions to execute DDL statements.

false: The account does not have the permissions to execute DDL statements
fields.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DDL权限，取值如下：

true：允许DDL。
false：禁止DDL
fields.name: ddl_authority

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant the DML permissions to the database account. Valid values:

0: The account has the permissions to read data from the database, write data to the database, and modify the settings of the database.

1: The account only has the permissions to read data from the database.

2: The account only has the permissions to read data from the database and modify the settings of the database
fields.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DML权限。取值如下：
0：允许进行读取、写入和更改设置的查询
1：仅允许进行读取数据的查询。
2：允许进行读取数据和更改设置的查询
fields.name: dml_authority

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service
parameters.name: product

Account.description_en: The name of the database account
